info.title: Armitage III
info.synopsis:
2046. Nella città di St. Lowell, su Marte, gli abitanti sono in procinto di rivoltarsi non solo a causa di una politica che favorisce e che protegge esclusivamente gli interessi delle grandi corporazioni ma anche per le pessime condizioni di vita dei cittadini e la presenza sempre più massiccia di androidi, usati per svolgere un numero sempre più ampio di lavori. Gli androidi sono sempre più simili all’uomo, gli uomini sempre più simili a macchine. Qual è il confine che ormai li divide? Un androide in grado di provare dolore, rabbia, amore e tutti quei sentimenti considerati “umani” perché deve essere trattato come un diverso?
Queste sono le contraddizioni del mondo in cui vive Naomi Armitage, androide di terza generazione (capolavori della tecnologia indistinguibili dagli esseri umani) che finge di essere umana per sfuggire alla discriminazione. Armitage lavora nel corpo di polizia di St. Lowell e le viene assegnato come compagno il detective Ross, a cui in passato un androide causò la morte della sua partner e lo privò della gamba destra. Che accadrebbe se scoprisse il segreto della sua nuova collega? I due si troveranno a indagare su una serie di omicidi legati ad androidi di terza generazione...

episodes.title: Electro sangue
episodes.synopsis: Armitage, a saucy Martian cop, and her partner, Sylibus, track a killer who is revealing his female victims' identities as highly-advanced androids. Sylibus discovers that Armitage is one of them before witnessing her dramatic standoff with the murderer.

episodes.title: Carne e pietra
episodes.synopsis: The killer, D'anclaude, is in custody, but the androids, called Thirds, are still dying. Armitage's disappearance leads Mars PD to suspect that she's involved in the murders. Only Sylibus knows why she has taken the case into her own hands.

episodes.title: Il cuore del nucleo
episodes.synopsis: Armitage desperately searches for connections between D'anclaude and her father, who designed the Thirds. She and Sylibus reunite to battle police forces and abduct the killer for questioning, where they are confronted by a crazed D'anclaude robot clone.

episodes.title: Un po' di amore
episodes.synopsis: Sylibus and Armitage locate her brain-washed father at a secret base on Dunwitch Hill, where their questions about the Thirds are finally answered. Armitage receives wicked battle upgrades before a final showdown with the Martian military.

info.title: Yakuza Fiancé: Raise wa Tanin ga Ii
info.synopsis: Yoshino Somei è una liceale nata e cresciuta in una famiglia di yakuza, il che non le ha però impedito di vivere una vita tranquilla e pacifica, almeno fin quando non incontra il suo fidanzato scelto dalla famiglia, Kirishima Miyama!

episodes.title: Non è un posto per perdenti
episodes.synopsis: Tra le due famiglie della yakuza Somei e Miyama sembra essere tornata la pace: Yoshino, nipote del boss Somei, deve andare a Tokyo per incontrare Kirishima, nipote del boss Miyama, con cui presumibilmente dovrà sposarsi. Kirishima è davvero il ragazzo gentile che sembra?

episodes.title: Voglio mostrarti la mia sincerità. E, se possibile, farti innamorare un po' di me.
episodes.synopsis: La figlia del presidente Akaza è scomparsa, o per rapimento oppure perché è semplicemente scappata di casa. Per la sua incolumità, Yoshino deve restare sempre con Kirishima, il quale ha molte informazioni sulla giovane scomparsa.

episodes.title: Il triangolo amoroso dell'inferno
episodes.synopsis: Proprio quando Kirishima e Yoshino iniziano ad avvicinarsi un po', da Osaka arriva un caro amico della ragazza.

episodes.title: Is He Smart or Stupid?
episodes.synopsis: After a tense encounter between Kirishima and Shouma, Shouma drives back to Osaka. Yoshino gets the sense that something is spoiling Kirishima's mood and confronts him. Like every year, Yoshino catches a summer flu.

episodes.title: The Camellia Princess
episodes.synopsis: After their final exams, Yoshino and Kirishima head to Yokohama to meet Yoshino's cousin, Tsubaki Akashigata, who recently moved from Kyoto. Reuniting after a long time, the three—Yoshino, Tsubaki, and Kirishima, who tagged along—explore the city together. They enjoy reminiscing and chatting about trivial things as they stroll through Yokohama. However, their fun is interrupted when Yoshino gets a call from school and has to leave, leaving the other two behind.

episodes.title: I'd Rather Be Hated if You're Indifferent – Part 1
episodes.synopsis: Returning to Japan after living abroad, Nao Shioda lands a job as a TV announcer. She crosses paths with Kirishima, her ex-boyfriend from the past. In front of their friends, the two pretend to be strangers, but when they find themselves alone, Kirishima gently speaks to Nao and hands her his contact information.

episodes.title: I'd Rather Be Hated if You're Indifferent – Part 2
episodes.synopsis: From her seat on the bus, Nao spots Kirishima and Yoshino walking together. Unable to ignore them, she gets off at the next stop to follow. However, it's Yoshino who approaches Nao first. The two women begin to talk, and the conversation inevitably turns to their shared connection: Kirishima.

episodes.title: If I’m Honest, I Want to Get Married – Part 1
episodes.synopsis: The semi-criminal group holding grudges against Yoshino and Kirishima, along with Azami Suou, had gathered under Ozu’s command. While Kirishima was with Nao, Yoshino spotted Ozu and his group and decided to carry out a plan on her own. Upon learning about Yoshino’s situation, Kirishima reluctantly contacted Shoma, the only person he could turn to in Osaka, to entrust Nao to him and head toward Yoshino. During this time, Kirishima called Yoshino, and the two made a significant "bet."

episodes.title: If I’m Honest, I Want to Get Married – Part 2
episodes.synopsis: Kirishima finds himself in the crowded chaos of a fireworks festival, while Yoshino and a group of delinquents gather nearby. Yoshino chases after Oz, who has been abducted by Naoya, while Kirishima blends into the crowd and launches a surprise attack on the delinquents. Targeted due to the incident involving Shiori Akaza, Yoshino is spotted by Naoya and faces imminent danger. Kirishima continues to take down the delinquents one by one, but a mysterious and dangerous figure, Azami Suo, suddenly appears before him.

episodes.title: If I’m Honest, I Want to Get Married – Part 3
episodes.synopsis: Azami's true intentions for searching for Yoshino and the words Minami said to Shoma before leaving remain shrouded in mystery as Azami and the others disappear without a trace. Left behind, Kirishima and Yoshino confront Ozu, who has been captured, demanding he settle Naoya's scandals and promise never to interfere with them again. Despite Ozu's skillful maneuvering, always stopping just short of breaking the law and avoiding creating any vulnerabilities, Kirishima sets a trap for him. With the case resolved, Kirishima earns the right to be Yoshino's boyfriend and enthusiastically presses forward, only for Yoshino to propose a certain challenge to him.

episodes.title: A Wild Creature You Can't Keep Once it Grows Up
episodes.synopsis: After visiting the Somei family grave, Kirishima is invited to the Somei group, where he spends a pleasant time. The group enjoys a barbecue together, sharing stories about young Tsubaki, who looked strikingly similar to Kirishima. Renji, one of Tsubaki's few close friends, reminisces about the past and shares nostalgic tales with Yoshino and Kirishima. However, the atmosphere becomes tense when Hotei returns from work. Summoned to the basement by Renji, Kirishima and Shoma are questioned about the uproar involving semi-outlaw groups that occurred in the Kansai region, a matter that also entangled Yoshino.

episodes.title: As She Fades, a Dark Night Falls, and the Rain Begins to Pour
episodes.synopsis: After a tumultuous visit to her hometown, Yoshino and Kirishima return from Osaka to the Miyama residence in Tokyo. They thought their usual daily life would resume as always, but from the very next day, Yoshino starts ignoring Kirishima. She alters her schedule to avoid him when going to school, ignores him when he speaks, and offers no response even when he cooks for her. A rare moment of distress overtakes Kirishima, who sits in the rain in front of the annex where Yoshino is staying. What is the reason Yoshino continues to ignore Kirishima...?

info.title: Gundam Evolve
info.synopsis:
I Gundam Evolve sono dei cortometraggi, in computer grafic, celebrativi di uscite di particolari kit in plastica. Infatti vengono venduti in bundle coi rispettivi modellini a cui fanno riferimemto.
Gundam Evolve I RX-78-2: un collage degli scontri sostenuti dall'RX-78-2 durante la guerra di un anno, mentre il collage è stato ottenuto con gli spezzoni dei film cinematografici, la sola parte in CG riguarda gli ultimi secondi del cortometraggio, dove si assiste al lancio di Gundam dalla Base Bianca. Decisamente misero come corto. Venduto in bundle assieme ala seconda edizione del Perfect Grade dell' RX-78-2
Gundam Evolve II RX-178 MKII: Test di combattimento simulato nello spazio su due modelli di RX-178, più una lunga carrellaa sul quello che nasconde sotto la corrazza l'RX-178. Venduto in bundle con al prima edizione del Perfect Grade dell'RX-178.
Gundam Evolve III GF-13-017 NJ II God Gundam: Esibizione di Tai-Chi da parte del God Gundam. con piccolo scambiodi opinioni tra Domon e Rain a bordo del Rising Gundam. Molto divertente per chi avrà visto G Gundam. Commemorativo dell'uscita del God Gundam versione Master Grade.
Gundam Evolve IV: Il Mobile Aemor Gundam Dendrobium difende la stazione spazile La Vie En Rose dall'assalto di una squadriglia di Gelgoog Marine. Il migliore degli Evolve, ricco d'azione e curato dallo stesso staff di Gundam 0083. Venduto in bundle con la prima edizione del Gundam Dendrobium HGUC 1/144

episodes.title: RX-78
episodes.synopsis: In this episode Amuro Ray, waiting to start in the final battle of A Baoa Qu, sits in his RX-78-2 Gundam while the other forces are already fighting. He recalls many of the battles he has fought until now, beginning with his fight against the mobile armor Elmeth when he killed Lalah Sune. Afterward he recalls the battle against the Black Tri-Stars, Ramba Ral and Char Aznable. He also thinks about the people important to him who died, including Ryu Jose, Matilda Ajan and Sleggar Law. Then he hears Sayla Mass who tells him that if they can overcome war, humanity should as well. Soon afterward, Amuro launches.

episodes.title: RX-178 Gundam MK II
episodes.synopsis: The events of this episode take place after the Gryps Conflict. The story revolves around a video tape which is sent to Kamille Bidan by Argama chief engineer Astonaige Medoz. On the video Astonaige wishes him a quick recovery and it also contains a video scene from a battle training at which Kamille participated during the Gryps Conflict. In the training he uses the Gundam Mk.II to fight against several drones and two Rick Dias in a combat simulation. Although he thinks it is too easy he accidentally destroys the camera probe recording the training. The episode ends with a written report by Kamille apologizing over damaging the suiveillance pod, in which he angrily wrote in later sections denying himself of any responsibility for the incident, protesting over having to write such a formal apology at all, and going further on to accuse his superiors Quattro Bajeena and Henken Bekkener of being totally irrational and incompetent.

episodes.title: GF 13-017 NJ II
episodes.synopsis: Domon Kasshu is practicing T'ai chi with the God Gundam. However suddenly Rain Mikamura appears in the Rising Gundam and attacks him because he was away for two days. He tells her he was only training but she believes that he was off chasing skirts, and the two fight.

episodes.title: Dendrobium RX-78GP03
episodes.synopsis: It is revealed that several people leaked information about the Gundam Development Project to the Zeon Forces because Jamitov Hymem dislikes it. Afterwards a ruined MS-14A Gelgoog is shown floating in space after a group of Gelgoog Marine Types and MS-06F Zaku II mobile suits attack the La Vie en Rose. To counter them a woman named Defrah Kar pilots the Gundam GP03 Dendrobium Stamen to destroy them. To make this easier she uses the Orchis platform and, thanks to its powerful weapons, is easily able to destroy them, and thanks to her I-field she is even able to defend herself from the attack of a large battleship. However, after the battle and while ejecting the Stamen from the Orchis, a severely damaged Gelgoog is able to shoot at the cockpit of the Stamen, killing Defrah and incidentally destroying the experimental cockpit. Afterwards the people who looked on the Gundam data examine the data of the GP04 Gerbera.

episodes.title: RX-93 Nu Gundam
episodes.synopsis: The episode begins with Quess, who had apparently used the NZ-333 Alpha Azieru to severely damage Hathaway Noa's RGM-89 Jegan. Afterwards Amuro Ray in his RX-93 Nu Gundam has a Newtype reaction to her and confronts her. He accuses her of not understanding Hathaway's feelings, but Quess doesn't listen and attacks him. However Amuro is able to trap her inside the Fin Funnel's beam barriers. Afterwards they hear Hathaway who tells Quess not to be angry, and Amuro tells Quess that Hathaway isn't dead. Thanks to this and Amuro's words she calms down and she finally uses the Alpha Azieru to rescue Hathaway.

episodes.title: YMF-X000A Dreadnought Gundam
episodes.synopsis: Things starts off with a battle between the YMF-X000A Dreadnought and several ZGMF-600 GuAIZ. Although Prayer Reverie tells them that he doesn’t want to fight they continue and one of them slams him in an asteroid. Suddenly a DRAGOON-equipped Dreadnought "ghost" appears, separates itself from the real Dreadnought and attacks the GuAIZ.

episodes.title: XXXG-00W0 Wing Gundam Zero
episodes.synopsis: This episode begins with a figure in a spacesuit (Heero Yuy) setting bombs, then fades to Gundam engineer Doctor J, apparently imprisoned. He talks to a shadowy visitor about history and his young protege as the person in space suit tries to escape the facility he has just sabotaged. The guards catch up to him, but he uses a nearby Virgo II mobile doll to distract them and escape to his machine - Wing Zero. Heero uses the twin buster rifle to break out of the base's hangar, but loses the weapon in the escape and resorts to using a Virgo II beam rifle. He is chased by several Virgo IIs along the length of the facility, which is actually a gigantic colony cannon. After dealing with his pursuit, Heero attacks the cannon directly with his beam rifle as the bombs begin to go off. Doctor J finishes his narration, commenting to his visitor (now revealed as Relena Peacecraft) that he chose Heero's codename personally. As the colony cannon explodes, Heero flies away to his next mission.

episodes.title: GAT-X105 Strike Gundam
episodes.synopsis: In a secret ZAFT desert base, the Aile Strike Gundam faces off against several GINN OCHER Types.

episodes.title: MSZ-006 Zeta Gundam
episodes.synopsis: In space there lies a giant mobile armor called the Psycho Weapon and it's decimating the EFSF fleets so it's up to 3 Zeta Gundams to destroy the huge weapon...

episodes.title: MSZ-010 ZZ Gundam
episodes.synopsis:
Judau is assigned to protect/escort the space transport ship Jupitris on his (probably also his girlfriend Roux Louka's) birthday. While on the recovery missions he encounters Neo-Zeon forces pursuing a AMX-004-3 Quebeley MK.II. Seeing the Quebeley posing no threat, Judau assists it in destroying the Neo-Zeon squad composed of Doven Wolfs riding on sub-flight platforms, allowing the Quebeley to land safely on Jupitris.

The last image of this short film shows a pilot whose face isn't seen, yet it bears a striking resemblance to an old friend (Puru 2)...

episodes.title: RB-79 Ball
episodes.synopsis: A Baoa Qu, the grounds of the final battle of the One Year War. As the scars of war remain fresh in the battlefield, novice Federation pilot Hiden surveys the area in a RB-79 Ball. Word comes in that Zeon remnants are about to attack. Though afraid, the young pilots proceed through the silent interiors of A Baoa Qu. Without warning, gunshots echo through the air and his party is decimated one-by-one. When Hiden, the sole survivor, presses further into the depths, he discovers the harsh reality behind war...

episodes.title: RMS-099 Rick Dias
episodes.synopsis:
Quattro Bajeena boards his Rick Dias for a battle simulation to transfer combat data to the mass-production model. The data personnel has some fun with him, turning the Rick Dias's monitor red, revealing his own old Zaku from his "Red Comet" days as his opponent. Quattro is gradually cornered by the Zaku... Can he win against the legendary Red Comet?

And then he switches to the Hyaku Shiki, and faces off with an old rival...

episodes.title: RMS-108 Marasai
episodes.synopsis: As the AEUG attempt to enter the atmosphere for the drop operation on Jaburo, they come under attack by the Titans' Marasai mobile suits. An orbital battle ensues...

episodes.title: SD Musha Gundam
episodes.synopsis: As evil Zaku bandits terrorise the country of Ark. Rekka Musha Gundam comes to the rescue chasing their leader Mazaku for the Scroll of Light he had stolen. Stopping briefly at a teahouse, Rekka informs three young kids about the Seven of Light Gundam team he leads. Suddenly Mazaku's Gelgoog minions set the building on fire. After defeating the minions, Mazaku appears and uses the Scroll to transform into the gigantic Hadou Musha Mazaku. Rekka is easily defeated by his gigantic and powerful foe. The children prepare to surrender but Rekka stands up and cries out. His noble spirit causes the Scroll to abandon Mazaku and give Rekka its true power, gifting him with the Armour of Light. With his new power and cheered on by the children, Rekka slices Mazaku in halves and saves the day.

episodes.title: RX-78 Gundam
episodes.synopsis:
The short is a re-imagined version of the 39th episode of the Mobile Suit Gundam TV series with updated mechanical designs.

"Challia Bull was found to have the attributes of a Newtype during his activities in the Jupiter Energy Fleet. While doubtful of his own abilities, he is recruited and assigned by commander-in-chief Gihren to serve in Char Aznable's combat unit under Kycilia's command. Even as he senses the girl he met, known as Lalah Sune, to be something of a Newtype, the fierce combat with the Federation ace-piloted Gundam changed his convictions...."

info.title: Dragon's Dogma (ITA)
info.synopsis: Dopo aver perso la casa, Ethan si mette alla ricerca del drago che gliel'ha distrutta per annientarlo una volta per tutte. Una pedina appare al suo fianco promettendo di proteggerlo, ma i pericoli che attendono Ethan vanno al di là di ogni immaginazione… perché a volte combattendo contro un mostro, rischi di diventarne uno anche tu.

episodes.title: Wrath
episodes.synopsis: Father-to-be Ethan leaves his wife behind and takes orphan Louis to hunt for food in the mountains, where a pack of ferocious wolves set upon them.

episodes.title: Gluttony
episodes.synopsis: Cassardis lies in ruins. When a magical Pawn revives Ethan, he vows revenge, embarking on a quest to slay the dragon that destroyed his world.

episodes.title: Envy
episodes.synopsis: Ethan and Hannah aid a traveling party being ambushed by goblins. The groups make camp together, but a predatory griffin swoops in from above.

episodes.title: Sloth
episodes.synopsis: The pair make their way through a cavern that once housed a bustling narcotics operation. Deeper inside, a towering hydra stalks the depths.

episodes.title: Greed
episodes.synopsis: Ethan and Hannah reunite with royal guards Simon and Balthazar, agreeing to help them destroy a greedy lich who commands an army of undead.

episodes.title: Lust
episodes.synopsis: Hannah convinces Ethan to rest at an inn before marching on to the dragon's lair. In his room, a vision of his wife brings back Ethan's past.

episodes.title: Pride
episodes.synopsis: Ethan makes his way to the Tainted Mountain to face the dragon and reclaim his stolen heart, or die trying.

info.title: Lupin III - La cospirazione dei Fuma (ITA)
info.synopsis: Lupin e Jigen si trovano al matrimonio del loro amico Goemon, che sposerà una giovane donna di nome Murasaki Suminawa. La sua famiglia possiede un ricco tesoro che sarà donato a Goemon subito dopo la cerimonia. Il prezioso tesoro è da secoli oggetto di desiderio del clan dei ninja di Fuma. Quest'ultimo giunge alla cerimonia nel tentativo di impossessarsi del ricco bottino, ma Lupin, Jigen e Fujiko fortunatamente impediscono la riuscita del furto. Il clan decide comunque di rapire la giovane sposa, chiedendo come riscatto un costoso vaso. Qualcosa però va storto, il nonno rifiuta il riscatto, e allora toccherà a Lupin e alla sua squadra salvare la ragazza e riportare tutto alla normalità. L'ispettore Zenigata, credendo Lupin ormai morto, decide di licenziarsi dal lavoro, ma un giorno, un suo amico poliziotto gli mostra una foto che lo ritrae al matrimonio di Goemon. Zazà, allora, insospettito, decide di riprendere il suo servizio, mettendosi immediatamente sulle tracce dell'invincibile ladro. Il nostro caro ispettore avrà finalmente la possibilità di incastrare Lupin una volta per tutte? Ma soprattutto, Lupin e i suoi riusciranno a proteggere l'inestimabile bottino dalle mani dei ninja?

episodes.title: Trappola mortale
episodes.synopsis: Dopo aver salvato alcuni uomini rinchiusi in una prigione, il cui direttore aveva il sadico passatempo di dare la caccia ai detenuti cui permetteva di tentare la fuga, Lupin si reca in un piccolo Paese del Sud Est asiatico, Zufu, per mettere le mani sul tesoro dell'ultima famiglia reale, da poco spodestata da un colpo di Stato guidato dallo spietato e sinistro generale Cacciateste. Il tesoro in questione però si trova su di un'isola resa inespugnabile da un sofisticato sistema cibernetico che uccide all'istante chiunque tenti di avvicinarsi alla cassaforte. L'unica persona in grado di rendere inoffensivo il sistema di sicurezza sarebbe il principe Pannish, che però risulta ufficialmente morto durante il golpe

info.title: You're Under Arrest: Full Throttle
info.synopsis: Kobayakawa Miyuki e Tsujimoto Natsumi tornano in questa terza stagione animata, come sempre per combattere il crimine di Tokyo presso il dipartimento di polizia di Bokuto.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.synopsis: On the airplane flight back to Tokyo, Miyuki meets and befriends a young boy who seems to be traveling alone. Natsumi has been training with the JSDF Rangers and is on her way back to Tokyo as well. But when Miyuki arrives at Tokyo, a man tries to take the boy, and given the boy’s reaction, it looks like abduction. Miyuki gets the boy back, and makes a run for it by car, but the guy pursues in a black sedan representative of the Yakuza mafia.

episodes.title: The Blue-Eyed Samurai
episodes.synopsis: As Miyuki and Natsumi get settled back at Bokuto Station, they have to deal with Randy, a billionaire’s 12-year old son who has been pursued by the Yakuza.

episodes.title: The Powerful, No-Parking Wrestler
episodes.synopsis: Bokuto station gets excited after Detective Tokuno brings over some taiyaki from a popular shop. But the shop is having trouble as someone has been moving cars off the road and stacking them against the wall.

episodes.title: Snake Panic at Bokuto Police Station
episodes.synopsis: While on routine traffic duty, Aoi and Yoriko spot a girl looking for something in the bushes, but when they are on the way back, they realize they have a big iguana in the back seat! The girl happens to be the owner of the lizard; Miyuki and Natsumi escort the girl back to her apartment which is full of reptiles. One of them, named Shou-kun, is a large snake which takes a liking to Miyuki, and hijinks arise when the duo returns to Bokuto, and the girl finds out Shou-kun has gone missing!

episodes.title: There`s a Baby Locked in the Car!
episodes.synopsis: A string of car break-ins has been going on at different public parking lots, and the Chief of Bakuto Station puts everyone on alert. But this time the guy who has been responsible finds a baby that was neglectfully locked in a car. The mom goes into a panic when she comes back and finds her car broken into and the baby missing.

episodes.title: Aoi Becomes a Man!?
episodes.synopsis: A police officer comes out of retirement to help out with things in Bokuto Station. Apparently the officer knows Aoi from some previous officer work, and since Aoi is still cross-dressing as a woman, the officer tries to turn Aoi into a man by giving him and the entire department some special training. Aoi doesn’t want to change his ways, but he and Natsumi stick with the training.

episodes.title: The Taxi Robber
episodes.synopsis: A taxi cab has been taking advantage of women who have gotten drunk and needed rides home by driving them away from the district and robbing them. Bokuto station has taxi inspections, but are unable to find the culprit. Miyuki uses her detective knowledge to guess a lead on the taxi’s next hit, and Natsumi decides to get drunk as her tactic.

episodes.title: Chief Has an Illegitimate Child?! A Dangerous Picnic
episodes.synopsis: Miyuki and Natsumi realize in all these years, they know very little about their chief’s personal life when they receive a visit from someone that could be his daughter.

episodes.title: Yoriko Nikaido, Bachelorette
episodes.synopsis: Yoriko has been feeling a bit down over her singleness and getting set up on dates by her mom to guys she could care less about. While Miyuki and Natsumi get assigned on a burglary case, Yoriko and Aoi get to give a class presentation on traffic safety to some kids who also discover she is single and make fun of her. She finds a fortune-teller who is somehow able to recognize her problems, but learns soon afterwards of that woman's fate and questions what to do next.

episodes.title: A Sudden Outbreak of Robots
episodes.synopsis: Bokuto Station receives a visit from a research company who is hoping to facilitate the police officer's tasks with some of their latest and greatest robots. They have Miyuki demonstrate manipulating a large robot that could be used for disaster rescues, and Natsumi gets to dress up in a body suit that boosts her muscular power. The robots are demonstrated at a convention but something goes wrong when someone named Doctor Suu shuts them down and brings in another robot.

episodes.title: To the Most Important Person in the World
episodes.synopsis: Ken watches a popular Korean TV drama and gets inspired to write a love letter confession to Miyuki, but has a really hard time finding the right circumstance to do so.

episodes.title: Finally, a Reality! A Dream Match!
episodes.synopsis: Detective Tokuno of the Criminal Affairs division visits the Chief for a friendly game of Go. Although the Chief always loses, Natsumi decides maybe there is a way for the Chief to win this time and rallies the Traffic department to challenge the Criminal Affairs division to a friendly game of baseball. While the teams play, Tokuno and Chief have their own Go battle again. But where there's baseball, there is bound to be the vigilante hero, Strike-Man!

episodes.title: Identity Revealed! The Great Unmasking
episodes.synopsis: Illegal garbage dumping hits the Bokuto district. Miyuki and Natsumi help Yoriko and Aoi investigate an abandoned recycling plant that has been overrun with trash, but Yoriko and Aoi have heard rumors that it is haunted.

episodes.title: Ten Thousand Suspects
episodes.synopsis: A white sedan knocks over a woman and her dog. The woman is unconscious but the dog manages to grab a bite out of the suspect's clothing. Miyuki and Natsumi find the dog at the crime scene. Meanwhile, Detective Tokuno reports that a bank has been robbed. Miyuki and Natsumi take the dog with them and find the white sedan that was involved in the hit and run, converging with Tokuno's group. However, the suspects have fled into a large costume parade nearby, so it'll take some animal instinct to figure out who are the culprits.

episodes.title: 24 Hours with the Bokuto Police Office!
episodes.synopsis: A film group wants to chronicle the daily life of a Bokuto Traffic department. After following the girls, the Chief, and Ken around, they conclude that the footage is rather droll and routine, so the director comes up with a plan. Miyuki and Natsumi are to be in the final scene, but while they pose, they spot a man on a rooftop about to jump.

episodes.title: Protect the Charity Event
episodes.synopsis: Chief informs the gang of a possible bomb threat at the Riverside Mall. The bomb is set to go off during a major shopping event that involves families and kids. Miyuki, Natsumi, Yoriko, and Aoi are assigned to search for the bomb, but they must wear mascot costumes and blend in with the festivities. Miyuki gets to wear the Mushroom costume, and she befriends a five-year-old boy and his younger brother. The younger brother makes off with a car model from a raffle but the older one tells him to return it since it's stealing but they freak out when Nakajima arrives at the scene. Will they find the bomb in time, and what will the boys do?

episodes.title: Natsumi Tsujimoto`s Dream-Like Day
episodes.synopsis: Natsumi catches a cold and has to stay home to recover. The illness gives Natsumi some really wild dreams including going to a fancy restaurant but realizing they are out of food, and confronting her old nemesis, Strike-Man. Meanwhile, Miyuki and the Bokuto gang search for a Spiderman like guy who has been breaking into apartments.

episodes.title: Three Policewomen in an All-Out Dash Along the Beach!
episodes.synopsis: The Bokuto girls (including Aoi) go on a beach trip for their day off. They also meet up with Saori who is stationed in the North side. Nakajima tries to visit the beach to work on his relationship with Miyuki, or at least see her in a swimsuit, but he gets stuck in traffic. After some volleyball and fun in the water, the girls learn from a beach vendor that some peeping tom has been taking pictures and posting them on the Internet, so the girls help Saori scout for culprits, and set up Miyuki, Natsumi, and even Aoi-chan as bait.

episodes.title: Business As Usual on the Bokuto Front
episodes.synopsis: Nakajima and Miyuki undergo some trouble in their relationship.

episodes.title: Bokuto Police Station: In Memory of an Innocent Love
episodes.synopsis: Miyuki attends a wedding in Okinawa of one of her classmates, and the gang get concerned about whether Miyuki will meet up with one of her first loves. What will Nakajima do?

episodes.title: Vigilante Racer: Part 1
episodes.synopsis: Bokuto station receives a wave of complaints about a reckless vehicle that emits a mysterious car exhaust fume.

episodes.title: Vigilante Racer: Part 2
episodes.synopsis: Nakajima gets injured during the pursuit, but he and Miyuki vow to continue after the lead phantom racer.

episodes.title: We`re Going to Arrest You!
episodes.synopsis: Miyuki and Natsumi have managed to capture the lead phantom racer. Aoi and Yoriko go on some adventures; will they be the next exciting Bokuto duo?

info.title: Redline
info.synopsis: In un futuro dove tutti i mezzi di trasporto funzionano con una sistema antigravità, le vecchie automobili che viaggiano su pneumatici sono delle rarità e vengono utilizzate soltanto come mezzo di intrattenimento in delle corse senza esclusione di colpi. Ogni cinque anni si svolge la più dura e distruttiva gara automobilistica dell'universo, la REDLINE, che attira tutti i migliori e più intraprendenti piloti da ogni angolo dello spazio conosciuto. JP è un pilota squattrinato, disposto a truccare le gare a cui partecipa pur di pagare i suoi debiti e continuare a correre. Nonostante abbia vinto pochissime gare, il suo look retro e gli spettacolari incidenti da cui esce sempre indenne, gli procurano il sostegno di numerosi fan in tutta la galassia. Dopo aver perso clamorosamente la YELLOWLINE contro la bella Sonoshee McLaren, JP si rassegna ad una lunga degenza in ospedale per poi tornare alla solita vita. Quando all'improvviso una folla di giornalisti fa irruzione nella sua camera d'ospedale con una notizia clamorosa. Dopo il ritiro di due partecipanti e grazie al voto del pubblico, JP si è qualificato per partecipare alla prossima REDLINE. Il problema è che la corsa si svolgerà su Roboworld, un pianeta che non permette intromissioni e che è disposto a mettere in campo tutta la sua potenza militare pur di fermare la famigerata gara. Ma JP non si lascia scoraggiare dai pericoli a cui potrebbe andare incontro e decide di mettersi in gioco. Al volante della sua Trans Am, si metterà sulla linea di partenza accanto a Sonoshee e agli altri scatenati concorrenti e farà di tutto pur di realizzare il suo sogno: tagliare il traguardo della leggendaria REDLINE in prima posizione!

episodes.title: Redline
episodes.synopsis: "Redline" is about the biggest and most deadly racing tournament in the universe. Only held once every five years, everyone wants to stake their claim to fame, including JP, a reckless dare-devil driver oblivious to speed limits with his ultra-customized car - all the while, organized crime and militaristic governments want to leverage the race to their own ends. Amongst the other elite rival drivers in the tournament, JP falls for the alluring Sonoshee - but will she prove his undoing, or can a high speed romance survive a mass destruction race?

info.title: No. 7 West Mars St.
info.synopsis: Durante i caotici viaggi del Capodanno Interstellare, con tutti i biglietti esauriti, il fumettista Li Ha dovette accontentarsi di un taxi spaziale così malconcio che la portiera non si chiudeva nemmeno bene. Quello che doveva essere un semplice trasferimento si trasformò in un'incredibile avventura: nello stesso giorno, Li Ha si ritrovò improvvisamente sposato e padre di due figli!

info.title: Mahou no Star Magical Emi: Kumo Hikaru
info.synopsis: In questa storia breve di 15 minuti, pubblicata più di 15 anni dopo il finale del popolare franchise Mahou no Star Magical Emi, una nuova vita è nata nella famiglia Kazuki. In che modo il fratellino ha cambiato la vita della famiglia e quali sono i sentimenti di Mai nei suoi confronti. Alla fine di una giornata movimentata per i fratelli e Shou, un altro concerto attende Emi.

info.title: Betrothed to My Sister's Ex
info.synopsis: Marie è la figlia di un nobile caduto in disgrazia e vive da sempre all'ombra della sorella. I suoi capelli rossi sono pieni di nodi e non possiede nessun abito a parte quelli logori che utilizza durante i lavori. Mentre lei conduce una vita da serva, la sorella Anastasia attira l'attenzione del conte Granado, uno degli uomini più belli e ricchi del regno che si vocifera sia un misogino dal carattere difficile. L'uomo, che si è innamorato a prima vista della ragazza, le chiede di sposarlo ma durante il viaggio verso il luogo del matrimonio avviene un incidente e Anastasia muore. Ora Marie, dopo che il padre ha già impiegato tutta la dote del conte e non ha modo di ripagarlo, si ritrova costretta a sostituire la sorella... ma a quanto pare c'è stato un malinteso fin dall'inizio riguardo la proposta di matrimonio!

episodes.title: I Could Never Replace My Sister
episodes.synopsis: Marie is always dressed in tatters and is treated like a servant in her own home. Then she meets Count Kyros.

episodes.title: Marie, I Want to Marry You
episodes.synopsis: Kyros hates aristocratic society and its ties of obligation. But why? And what changed when he met Marie?

episodes.title: A Life I Saw in a Dream, and a Dream-like Life
episodes.synopsis: Marie begins her new life as Kyros' fiancée and finds herself bewildered by the differences from her old life.

episodes.title: I`ve Found the Things I Like
episodes.synopsis: Cyrus wants to give Marie the highest level of hospitality, while Mio sees her own origins in Marie's timidity. The two decide to create a comfortable environment for Marie, but the next day, a malicious letter and package arrives for Marie from the Baron's family. The letter from the Baron's family was supposed to be inspected by Cyrus or Mio, but with Ilsa and Hanna's help, it is handed directly to Marie...!?

episodes.title: The Prince and the Pitch-Black Warrior
episodes.synopsis: Luiphon takes Marie to a sword fighting contest. The ferocity of it scares her. Then the dark warrior fights.

episodes.title: A Gift More Lovely Than Jewels
episodes.synopsis: Kyros and Marie meet Luiphon at a jeweler's at his request. Thoughts of Anastasia haunt Marie's happiness.

episodes.title: In Pursuit of Anastasia`s Spirit
episodes.synopsis: Kyros demands the truth of Anastasia's accident, but he and Marie are not prepared for the answers they find.

episodes.title: Please Call Off the Betrothal
episodes.synopsis: Worried, Kyros arranges to meet with Norman. But as Marie hears him describe his apprentice, her fears grow.

episodes.title: The Empty Princess Lives
episodes.synopsis: Marie's attacker talks about the past. Why did little Marie's life change so much? Why was she left in rags?

episodes.title: It`s Time to Settle This
episodes.synopsis: Marie is determined to settle things. But even with everyone's help, how will she confront her parents?

info.title: A.D. Police: To Protect and Serve
info.synopsis:
Ambientato qualche anno prima di Bubblegum Crisis Tokyo 2040, A.D. Police narra le vicende della divisione speciale di polizia di Mega-Tokyo, creata per controllare i Boomer impazziti nella città.

L'ufficiale dell'A.D. Police Kenji Sasaki si trova di fronte a un grave dilemma: ha appena perso un altro partner per mano di un boomer rabbioso. Il giorno dopo essere stato messo in aspettativa, gli viene assegnato un nuovo compagno, il poliziotto tedesco Hans Kleif. La cosa strana è che Kenji aveva dato un pugno a tradimento a Hans in un bar la sera prima. Non solo Kenji deve affrontare il compito quotidiano di controllare i Boomer, ma ora deve anche fare i conti con il suo nuovo partner.

episodes.title: Partner
episodes.synopsis: Sasaki Kenji, a young AD Police member who always ignores his partner and solves each case by himself. Many of his partners have been wounded by that attitude. This time, his partner Paul is seriously injured during a mission and rumors says that nobody will team up with him anymore. One night, he goes to his usual bar and has a huge fight with a German named Hans. The next day, a new partner is waiting in his office, Hans, who he fought with the previous night!

episodes.title: Runaway
episodes.synopsis: Even though Kenji got a new partner he hardly talks to Hans. This pissed Hans off to the point that Hens stops talking to Kenji too. During this "cold war", Kenji's ex-partner Paul who is involved in a voomer case on the way to a new hospital. The Voomer driver goes wild and turns into a Nano Stampede. Even though Kenji and Hans don't speak a word, they rescue Paul through perfect teamwork. Hans is treated by a beautiful nurse, Agemi, he met earlier at the hospital.

episodes.title: Bargaining
episodes.synopsis: A.D Police set off on a mission to destroy the illegal voomer factory. However, the Syndicate's main henchman Liam sets up a trap that stops the AD police action. Kenji is angry at the Syndicate and decides to complete the mission by himself again. The only person who follows him without a word is Hans. The two of them complete the mission and the trust between the partners seems to be growing stronger now.

episodes.title: Promise
episodes.synopsis: The only time Kenji feels relaxed is when he is with his girlfriend Kyouko. Kyouko is a college student in music school and she is going to have a graduate concert in the museum near her home. Kenji promises that he will be there but Kyoko is kidnapped by voomers that day! Kenji takes risky action trying to save Kyoko. The other AD Police members stop his dangerous actions and set up a plan to rescue Kyoko. This time, Kenji finally realizes how important teamwork and trust in your teammates is.

episodes.title: Strategy
episodes.synopsis: Liam gives himself up to the police. He claims that he made mistake at work that he is afraid that his boss, Mesion, will punish him so he is willing to trade industry secrets with the police in exchange for his safety. AD Police believe him and set up a trap for the latest Genom voomer delivery car that Laim said Meison are targeting. However what they don't know is that this is Liam's plan to take over Genom's newest voomer.

episodes.title: Family
episodes.synopsis: The AD Police successfully seized many illegal voomers from the Paker Syndicate. It was all because of Jose's great trap that the mission went so well. But Liam gets very angry and kidnaps Jose's wife and kid. Liam asks to trade Jose's family's safety for the illegal voomers. AD Police finally rescues the hostages but a time bomb suddenly explodes!

episodes.title: Bloodstains
episodes.synopsis: AD Police is keeping an eye on Liam after they got information that Liam secretly trading with Genom Tower. Kenji and the other members set up a mission to capture Liam and chase him into Genom tower. Suddenly a mysterious old man shows up to protect Liam and set him free. From the bloodstain Liam left they find out later that Liam is a Bio-voomer!

episodes.title: Memory
episodes.synopsis: Kenji's only relative-his grandfather visit AD police office looking for Kenji. But Kenji refuse to meet him and sneak to the bar "Lost City". Kenji's teammates later visit Lost City and try to convince him to meet his grand father. But Kenji decline there is no need to bring up memories of his past. Hans told Kenji that he lost all of his memories in an accident and he always feel anxious about who he really is and to his past. After listening to confess of his past, Kenji finally changed his mind.

episodes.title: Conviction
episodes.synopsis: Hans is seriously injured in a battle with voomer. Kenji taught Hans will never recovered but to his surprise, Hans recover in an amazing speed! Kenji suspicious about who Hans really is and checking Hans's blood to find the truth. But the truth told Kenji that Hans is a bio-voomer that not even Hans himself knows it!

episodes.title: Plunder
episodes.synopsis: AD Police member happily welcome Hans back to office but Kenji is holding an complex feeling. The first job after Hans come back is tracing Liam who stole the latest bio-voomer earlier. Kenji and Hans visit Genom and surprisingly find out Ageme is there! Agemi is not nurse, she is the leader of bio-voomer research team in Genom! Hans start to suspend himself is a bio-voomer too!

episodes.title: Dishonesty
episodes.synopsis: Liam is tracked into a corner by AD Police but he escape into reactor in the center of Tokyo. He pulls out the control rod of atomic reactor and decides to bring Tokyo with him to hell. Kenji are ready to give up his live to stop Liam but Hans knock him down and entered the reactor instead. Hans assured he is a bio-voomer and transfigure to a ugly bio-voomer to kill Liam.

episodes.title: Proof
episodes.synopsis: Kenji rush to Genom Tower to rescue Hans who is captured by Genom. Kenji and Hans are about to escape to somewhere Genom couldn't reach them but it is too late. Hans's transfiguration getting more serious and the chairman of Genom-Umihara is attacking Kenji for Kenji knows too much. Hans and Kenji team up again to destroy Umihara but Hans has run out of his strength and pass over in silence..

info.title: Yowayowa Teacher
info.synopsis: Akihito Abikura è uno studente liceale del secondo anno che si ritrova una nuova insegnante di inglese appena laureata. Hiyori Hiwamura ha una personalità timida, con una voce debole e scarsa prestanza fisica che quasi invoglia a proteggerla. Purtroppo, però, il suo carattere e la sua voglia di impegnarsi vengono fraintese dai suoi studenti: in breve tempo riceve l'appellativo di "insegnante spaventosa", e iniziano a girare voci che maledica le persone quando si arrabbia utilizzando uno strano quaderno pieno di post-it. Un giorno, Akihito, rimasto a scuola, vede Hiyori insegnare in un'aula vuota con solamente un animale di peluche davanti a lei... e rimane scioccato da quale sia la realtà. Alla fine l'insegnante non è affatto spaventosa, ma solamente incompresa, e Akihito è deciso ad aiutarla a superare la sua timidezza.

episodes.title: A Weak and Wimpy "Best Summer Ever"
episodes.synopsis: The best summer ever isn't about one moment. It's about spending time together.

episodes.title: Strong and Sturdy Feelings
episodes.synopsis: While Akihito's injury turns into a spectacle, Mizuki grapples with her feelings.

episodes.title: A Weak and Wimpy Jump Rope Tournament
episodes.synopsis: Hiyori is bound and determined to help her students win the sports day jump rope contest. Unfortunately for her, keeping up proves harder than expected.

info.title: Black Clover (ITA)
info.synopsis: In un mondo dove la magia è al centro della vita quotidiana è nato Asta, un ragazzo completamente privo di ogni abilità  magica. Suo amico è Yuno, al contrario dotato di grande forza magica; i due sono fin da piccoli rivali e hanno deciso di competere per il titolo di Imperatore Stregone, la più alta carica magica del loro regno.
